construct: Warm-reactive IgG binds erythrocyte surface antigens. Splenic macrophages recognize Fc-coated erythrocytes and partially phagocytose or remove them from the circulation, producing predominantly extravascular hemolysis and microspherocyte formation.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: IgG-positive DAT with jaundice, splenomegaly, reticulocytosis, and spherocytes identifies warm AIHA; Fc-bearing splenic macrophages mediate predominantly extravascular clearance of IgG-coated cells.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Cold IgM/complement disease, G6PD oxidation, microangiopathic fragmentation, and hereditary-spherocytosis membrane instability are genuine hemolytic mechanisms, but only splenic Fc-mediated clearance fits IgG-positive warm AIHA.
